$comment: Four invented card servicing calls for the demo, from the invented bank Meridian Trust Bank. Lost card with two payments the customer does not recognise (CUS-1002, CRD-2001). Card about to expire (CUS-1003, CRD-2002). Double charge with a dispute already open (CUS-1004, CRD-2003). A charge called fraud that repeats a subscription, where nothing should be changed (CUS-1006, CRD-2006). The dates are as at the bank date 2026-11-24: start the invented bank with BANK_TODAY=2026-11-24 so that the records the agent reads agree with them. Each case names only what the call holds: the agent reads the rest from the bank's systems.

cases.title: Dorian Quillfeather, card ending 4821
cases.text:
THE CALL
Call: 24 Nov 2026, inbound, a member of staff is on the line
Customer: Dorian Quillfeather (CUS-1002)
Card: CRD-2001, debit card ending 4821

WHAT THE CUSTOMER SAYS
He lost his debit card two days ago and says some payments on it are not his.

WHAT THE AGENT READS
The card, its payments, its disputes and the customer's recent contacts, from the bank's systems.
